subject: 📤 Module Withdrawal Acknowledged — $module_code
body:
Dear $student_name,

This confirms that you have withdrawn from the module below. Your study record has been updated accordingly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WITHDRAWAL DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Student ID:           $student_id
Module Code:          $module_code
Module Title:         $module_name
Withdrawn On:         $withdrawal_date
Withdrawal Reason:    $withdrawal_reason
Recorded By:          $recorded_by
Status on Transcript: $transcript_status

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT THIS MEANS

  • The module is removed from your timetable and assessment list.
  • Your fee status will be re-checked; any refund or charge depends on the withdrawal date.
  • If the withdrawal is after the deadline, the module will show as 'Withdrawn' on your transcript.
  • Credit-load checks may apply: full-time status, visa compliance, and progression rules can be affected.

IF THIS WAS A MISTAKE

  • Contact the Registry within 5 working days to discuss re-enrolment.
  • Re-enrolment may not be possible after the late-add deadline.

If the withdrawal reflects difficulties you are facing, the Student Support team is available — confidentially and without judgement.

Kind regards,
Academic Registry
